name: Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon
wookieepedia_title: Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon
description: The Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon was a blaster cannon manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc., and was one of the weapons used to defend the Rebel Alliance's Echo Base from invading Imperial forces during the Battle of Hoth.
